items.html: Afterwards, in the Gadlut, the inner aspect entered, which is the KHB in nine Sefirot, and they were clothed little by little within the nine Sefirot of the middle aspect, which are only the ChGT NHY of the middle aspect. And now this middle aspect grew in the aspect of the nine Sefirot of its KHB; for since the inner aspect entered, which is all of it the aspect of KHB, as mentioned, therefore the KHB that are in the middle aspect also grew and were revealed.
